ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (light gray/white) to low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels form a continuous perimeter band along the trailing edge and distal tips. A central low-intensity mass radiates from the peduncle junction. High-intensity pixels dominate the medial lobe sections, interspersed with dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 85 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge. Distal tips (apices) show higher-amplitude, irregular jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a sigmoid curve, characterized by slight concavity near the median notch transitioning to broad convexity toward the mid-lobe and distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular, high-intensity (white) pixel groups are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the high-intensity regions of both lobes, appearing as distinct scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the medial and distal surfaces; visible barnacle colonization at the lobe apices.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct feathered or mottled transition zone exists between the low-intensity peduncle pigmentation and the high-intensity lobe centers.
